notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.6
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello heroes! 

We’ve made the following bug fixes and balance updates to Slime Heroes today. We’ve also done a lot more Multiplayer sync fixes between players.[/h1]

[h2]Balance Notes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Lowered flathead enemies’ attacks by 10%
[*] Equalized battle dungeon enemies bonus health and damage to 140%
[/list]
[h2]Single Player[/h2]

[list]
[*] Player couldn’t rotate sometimes after using skills
[*] The player couldn’t move sometimes after leaving the Orion Menu
[*] Humming sound effects constantly playing
[*] Removed an invisible barrier in the Decoy Dungeon
[*] The level-up system would not allow an upgrade when the shard count is exactly equal to the cost
[*] Lots of localization fixes for text
[/list]
[h2]Online Multiplayer[/h2]

[list]
[*] Second-player jitters when using basic and heavy attacks 
[*] All enemy health bars appear on first player's screen when the second player joins
[*] Slime jump causes unintended jittering forthe  second player when double jump is enabled
[*] Enemies are falling through the world sometimes when the second player joins
[*] Second player dash would not restore sometimes
[*] The second player dodge recovery accessibility setting wasn’t working
[*] Ice desync between both players
[*] Enemies' health bars were not synced up betweenthe  first and second player
[/list]

See more bugs? Game updates and bug fixes are ongoing, and we’re actively checking bug reports on [url=https://forms.gle/RjCPHikfhTVwwg617]Bug Report Form[/url]

Feel free to join our Discord for more communication and updates!

notes.title: Slime Heroes (PC) Review
notes.notes:
I was initially intrigued by Slime Heroes because it feels like recently—due in large part to games like Dragon Quest—the public perception of Slimes has definitely shifted. When once they were only seen as gelatinous cubes that would dissolve any adventurer foolish enough to cross paths with them, now they are adorable companions and sometimes even heroes.

Slime Heroes certainly had a solid premise behind it, and I was gearing up for a game that put the lovable blobs front and center. However, the game never really lives up to its potential in a lot of different ways and comes off as a fairly bog standard ARPG. It’s not really bad, but, like the Slime it’s based on, it could’ve been so much more. 

Slime Heroes starts fairly simple. Players take on the role of a Slime, living in a quiet valley with their friend, who is an incredibly powerful dragon. However, things quickly take a turn when a terrible blight overruns their home, and it becomes filled with... Read more

notes.title: Update - New Release Date for Slime Heroes Announced
notes.notes:
We regret to announce that Slime Heroes’  launch on Steam, originally scheduled for February 13, has been unavoidably delayed until Thursday, March 6, 2025. 

We know how excited everyone was about its planned Thursday release, however, in the interest of ensuring that players have the best possible experience, a decision was made to take some extra time to make sure this happens.

We understand the disappointment this news may cause, and we sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this delay may bring to our fans, supporters, and partners. We are doing our best to keep the delay period to a minimum. 

We truly appreciate your continued support, patience, and understanding.

For further updates, be sure to drop Slime Heroes a wishlist and follow the game on Steam, our social channels including [url=https://twitter.com/Slime_Heroes]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/Slime-Heroes-103515111977108]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/slimeheroesgame/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@slimeheroesgame]TikTok[/url], and by joining our official [url=https://discord.com/invite/WhitethornGames]Discord[/url] server.

notes.title: Whitethorn Games Announces Publishing Partnership With Pancake Games
notes.notes:
Hey Heroes!

Tomas here, founder and CEO of Pancake Games. The team and I are excited to announce that Pancake Games has partnered with publisher Whitethorn Games to bring Slime Heroes to launch! 

We’ve been doing a lot of work behind the scenes this year, and we’re really excited to give you a peek at some of the things we’re cooking up for the game at launch. As part of the showcase, we revealed a new trailer for Slime Heroes featuring one of the many bosses you’ll encounter in the game. You can watch that below:

[previewyoutube=W6bWP5GDF9I;full][/previewyoutube]

Throughout the game, you and your slime will get to explore a wide, open world with distinct regions that come with their own puzzles and challenges for you to overcome. In the new trailer, we’re showing off the fiery volcanic region with winding, rocky paths surrounded by molten pits filled with lava that must be avoided at all costs. Only the most resilient, corrupted monsters can tolerate such a hostile environment, so you’ll need to make use of your skills and magical powers to make your way through this treacherous area. But be wary — a blazing hot boss bent on your destruction awaits you!

That’s all for now! We have a lot more to share in the coming months, so be sure to give Slime Heroes a wishlist and follow us on our Twitter to make sure you don’t miss a thing!

Tomas & the Pancake Games Team
